description: A piece of sheet music, stored as its notation source rather than as a rendering. The score is the text: any reader that speaks the format can engrave it, and the record stays legible even if every program that produced it disappears.

composer.description: Who wrote it. Absent for a piece with no attribution.

format.description: Which notation language `source` is written in. `lilypond` is what clef reads and writes; the others are named so a future reader can tell what it is looking at rather than guessing.

source.description: The notation source itself. This is the score — not a rendering of it.

license.description: How the piece may be used, e.g. 'public domain', 'CC BY-SA 4.0'. Absent means the author has said nothing, which is not the same as public domain.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written.
